fact: Car 31 moved prior to the Start
offence: Breach of Article 48.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed in-car video evidence. The evidence shows that there was movement prior to the start signal but after the 4 second light, so the standard penalty is applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 31 False Start Moving Before Signal
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
